source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The added task opens the Alice hidden-recipient fixture and asserts its body text, no signed icon and an encrypted-ok icon. The source does not explicitly create several differently protected keys or assert the per-fingerprint password choice, cancellation, failure cleanup or used-recipient key-ID display. Those are separate coverage limits even though the implementation loops over candidates. Static fixture identity and test assertions do not establish a successful crypto run.
title: The hidden-recipient display test covers the Alice fixture rather than distinct key passwords
